_doc: Every entry needs a `status` and a `reason`. Two statuses exist and they
synthetic  - not a finding at all. The matched text is a planted test
canary or a fixture value that was never real.
awaiting_operator - a REAL finding in a file this hardening pass is not
authorized to modify. It is approved only in the sense that
it does not fail the gate; it is still outstanding, and the
scanner prints it under OUTSTANDING on every run so it
Adding an entry to silence a finding you could have fixed is misuse.

tests/smoke.py.reason: Planted redaction canaries of several pinned classes. They exist to prove the floor redacts them; each is a literal invented for the test and was never a valid credential.

tests/test_gate_atomic.py.reason: Planted canary 'sk-abcdefghijklmnop1234' asserting disclose() redacts exact bytes before the egress row is written.

tests/test_loop_scan_gate.py.reason: Planted canary proving the loop-scan payload is receipted post-redaction.

tests/test_provenance_closure.py.reason: Planted canary proving the verifier grounds quotes against post-redaction disclosed bytes.

tests/test_reconcile_gate.py.reason: Planted canary proving the reconciler dispatches only receipted, redacted payloads.

tests/test_privacy_boundary.py.reason: The credential-canary suite itself. Every value here is invented for the test and is asserted to be absent from every persistence and output surface.

tests/test_repository_privacy.py.reason: Planted-positive fixtures for this scanner: the file deliberately contains one example of each detected class so a detector that silently stops matching is caught.

experiments/restore_scale/results.json.reason: Four occurrences of one real archive UUID inside a tracked benchmark result artifact. experiments/ is outside this pass's MAY-modify scope, and editing a recorded result is not path sanitization. Needs an explicit operator decision: rewrite the artifact, or accept it.

runs/handoff-20260812/final-report.md.reason: One real session UUID in a tracked benchmark conclusion. Same constraint: run artifacts may only receive portable path sanitization, and a session id is not a path.

tests/fixtures/legacy_archive.json.reason: The frozen legacy-archive fixture. Its rows deliberately reproduce the SHAPES that mattered before hardening — including claude:// session URIs and role-tagged dialogue — because a migration test against a fixture that lacks them proves nothing. Every value is invented; tests/test_security_migration.py asserts the fixture still carries these shapes.

contextd/redact.py.reason: The file that DEFINES the redaction floor. Its url_param pattern enumerates auth-shaped parameter names, so the pattern text matches itself. Unavoidable self-reference: a scanner built on these patterns will always flag their definition.

contextd/capability.py.reason: The dispatch-capability module documents its own `secret` field in a docstring, which the password_assignment pattern matches. No value is present; the field holds a per-issue random token returned once and stored only as a hash.

docs/SECURITY.md.reason: The security contract names each pinned redaction class, including basic_auth_url with its scheme://user:pass@host shape. Documenting what is detected necessarily contains the shape being detected.

scripts/repository_privacy_allow.json.reason: This allowlist itself. Explaining why a canary is approved requires naming its class, and the api_key pattern matches the sk- prefix convention referenced in a reason string.

tests/test_derivation_capability.py.reason: Dispatch-capability suite; asserts a capability secret never reaches the archive, so the word appears in assignments the password_assignment pattern matches. Every token is randomly generated at test time.

tests/test_process_isolation.py.reason: Planted canary proving a refusal message never quotes an argument value, and that no private key material sits on any client-visible surface. Invented literals only.

tests/test_security_doctor.py.reason: Planted canary proving the doctor's report carries no archive content. An invented literal, asserted absent from the doctor's output.
